snippet.title: Prince Jackson's Untold Stories of Michael Jackson | Part 2
snippet.description:
"Prince Jackson Opens Up About Growing Up on Neverland Ranch | Exclusive Interview"

📌Remembering Michael: A Mother’s Story is here:
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0F99DMH3C
Celebrity Classified: 
https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=Eiqb8Ryqogo&pp=iggCQAE%3D&ra=m

Join Prince as he takes us on a journey through his own little world at Neverland, reflecting on his experiences. He discusses wearing masks and initially feeling like it was excessive, but soon understanding his father's intention to protect their identities. Prince delves into the complexities of handling his father's immense fame and his own role in the family business, like helping with emails and setting up the technology in Michael's studio.

Stay tuned as Prince reveals how he discovered his father's fame by searching the internet and subsequently confronting Michael about it. He candidly shares the conversations they had, where Prince questioned why his father wanted to shield them from his name, wishing to be seen simply as "daddy."

Prince also delves into his father's music, recognizing it as the best and wondering what made Michael the Greatest of All Time (GOAT). He reminiscences about being in the studio with Michael during the creation of the Invincible album, feeling at ease amidst the loud sounds and even assisting his father with mixing and sound. Furthermore, Prince discusses Michael's fondness for photography, recounting moments when he was woken up in the middle of the night to lend a hand.

Ultimately, Michael's advice to Prince to never stop working and to be the best in whatever he chooses in life echoes throughout this revealing conversation. Don't miss out on this exclusive interview that sheds light on the extraordinary upbringing of Prince Jackson.
